beats: A week in, my job board already had two hundred listings. Finding the right ones took ten clicks and five minutes of scrolling.
Every filter click meant waiting on hundreds of rows redrawing on screen.
So I rebuilt the table with virtual scrolling — it renders only the rows you can actually see.
Now filtering by city, score, and company takes three clicks. One click excludes a recruiter.
Five minutes of scrolling became two seconds, lag-free past five hundred rows.
